FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Dollar Weakens on Rising Yields and Geopolitical Risk
tldr_points: US Treasury yields rise, exerting downward pressure on the dollar.
Geopolitical escalation around the Strait of Hormuz boosts safe‑haven demand for the yen.
Technical oversold conditions (RSI ~27) limit upside, reinforcing a bearish bias.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY pressuredby rising yields and geopolitical risk;oversold technicals suggest bounce before near further downside!
FX.comment: Rising yields and geopolitical risk bolster yen strength while technical resistance at MA20 favors a short entry.
